title: More chances for image requests to succeed
summary:
Image generation got more fallback routes, affiliate recommendations became more selective, and a community chatbot joined the directory.

Image generation gained Dreamshaper and Turbo server fallbacks between Cloudflare Flux and ComfyUI. Dreamshaper requests also avoid a seed parameter that caused errors.

Affiliate matching now prefers higher-priority offers when they are equally relevant and filters offers blocked in the request's country when country information is available. The eligible offer list was also updated.

The LLM Integrations list now includes Aura Chat bot, a community chatbot built with Pollinations text and image generation.
